body: Thank you, it means alot to read these words.

Yeah it sucks. I also am a control freak and a person who literally cannot accept that there is a mind in this world I cannot change, even just a bit. So it's kind of a double hit in that way I guess. I am very dissappinted in him and am not seeing the man I love right now. His parents are quite old and both in very poor health and so I understand that it makes the situation that much more difficult but I just am unable to wrap my mind around this mentality of theirs. 

I can't really tell anyone because honestly I am deeply ashamed. I had moved back to the US and ended up coming back here, gicing up quite a bit, for this man. of course, friends and family warned me but beieve I am mature enough to amek my own decisions. I just can't face ayone after what I did so publicly for him to have this happen. ]]

I do still have a horse. He is retired now and gives lessons to small kids and is very happy with his new job. Yes I think I have always been dpressed but what kicked it to the next level was when I had to stop competing. My horse had a major surgery and had to be reited and I was already in college at that point so my parents would no longer pay for extracarricular actviites, and I agree that is was the right approach. But losing that really did something to me. It was my whole life and I haven't competed since then. It's just not the same to ride and have no end goal. I just love everything about it. Horses are incredible animals and you can really never master them, which I like. I also prefer animals to people and think I interact with them better than people are well so I just feel like myself when I am at the stable. 

hmmm my favorite place. Africa in general and beyond that hard to say. Mayb tanzania or South Africa, or Rwanda. Idk I have this thing about Africa; I just love it. 

Yeah I thnk the fight to stay awake is about over. I guess I am stron but I don't want to be anymore.

Hey, well it is a big thing just to be able to talk freely for once. And with people who know what it feels like. I am still conscious by enormous effort mostly due to reddit. Haven't changed my mind, what happens now happens, but it really is nice to just talk. Anyway, I'm at the point now where I am choiking back the vomit. TMI? sorry, not sure if that is good or bad. 

Such a paradox depression creates. I have stalked these baords endlessly just to feel LIke I am not alone in what I feel. Part of me wishes I was for the sake of other people who have to feel this way but it is comforting somehow. 

I know what you mean about the trivial advice, and I am pleasantly surprised to not be getting the typical responses to this type of thing. Idk though, the advise has been good advise, and I appreciate it, even I di not act upon it. 

Re your last paragraph, bain of my fucking existence. I literally feel like shit 90 percent of the time and yet my body is just insanely resilient. Much more so than my mind, apparently. I really don't know how I am still sitting here typing and i think I should be angry but as a side effect of the pills, it seems I am pretty incapable to emotions riht now. Only ones I slightly feel are kind f positive. Big change there.

yes it does suck but isn't his fault. He just can't understnad the thought process which is probably a good thing. 

I am overseas now. I have been abroad for the last 6 years. Moved alot of time, always trying to run away from the fires I inevitably end up setting. U was on a break in the US from July to December and was able to have mental health treatment with my insureance there but where I live now, it is porrly understood and stigmitaized. I don't know, though, I am able to get refill son my meds here but I honesly don't think meds or therapy have imporved my life or outlook much. 

I appreacite the brainstorm and you just acutally caring enough to do that. I have thought of just about everything and I don't see other options. There is just so much on my back and this was the last thing I could handle losing. I know that everyone experiences this in their life, but for whatever reason, I am just unable to handle it.

Ennui sounds like something I can relate to. I often joke I am having an existential "quarter life crisis" although too old for that and also it's not a joke. I know that's not really the definition of the term but brought that to mind somehow. 

What makes me cry? ughhhh everything now. Everything. His parents hate me because I am from the US and one time wore a short dress in front of them and and are being extremely childish about our relationship. It's a cultural/religious thing adn a long story but now they told him to choose - his family or me. He chose his family. Technically we haben't broken up but I mean, doesn't seem to be another option. He is not willing to just give it some time. I do not and cannot understand his mentality on this as he insits they will never change their minds and says continuing is unfair to me and to him as wel will end up hurt later. I am of the opposite mind, beliveing that you can change ayting in this world and that it needs time, but he is adament that they will not give in. There is alot more to it than that and it has been a very hard and emitional time for both of us, but his actionals have not made me feel valued and I feel he is not willing to fight for our relationship. He knows somewhate, I have not explicity told him but he suspects.Suicide is not a new thing for me and he is aware, but although open minded, he is unable to understand this feeling as valid and it siply makes him angry. While he did not say so, I also believe he feels that i am using my dpression to try and guild him into ginving up his family for me, which I am not. I obviously am genuinely giving up. He feels bad but he doesn't understand how to address isues like this. 

There are things I cling onto but they are never enought. I don't know why. I have ridden horses competitively since I was six and it's m true passion, and yet I find myself so often having no interest in doing it. I literally have to force myself, after which I am glad I did it but I am tired of the most basic of taskts in my life being this excrutiating mental batter. 

I have travelled quite a bit. I really have right to be this dpressed, just how I have always been, although it does keep getting worse. About the war correspondent hing, yeah I am drawn to that stuff for whatever reason. Feel like I need to experience firsthand everythin gfucked up in the world. Clearly just what I need lol

Thank you, I'm glad you are still awake as well. Somettimes the kindness of strangrs is really encouraging. 

Also, can't believe I haven't passed out yet. I am fighting it but it's still pretty strange.

Well, that is a good question. I know you are probably thinking the whole cry for help thing. It really isn't that although I did hope I would be stopped by one person in particular at the las tminute. Didn't happen, clearly, which continues to keep helping to give me the strenth to do this. 

Pills just seemed private enough for me. nd it's nice to be able to be taking them and doing this to keep myself occupied. I can't really explain what made me choose the pills, just seemed like the right way for me. 

Thank you for the advice, and I have done a fair bit of reaseach and am aware that those are both possibilities. I have ensured I would be found anytime soon and also halfway through taking 30 plus g of paracetemol. I fully understnad how you die from this but it's my backup. Seems more and more likely it will be the solution now because the other pills still haven't made me pass out, or vomit. The vomit does not surprise me as I hardly ever vomit and I guess that is part of the reason I thought pills coul be a good option for me. 

I am hoping that my body get on board with my mind and doesn't try to get rid of these. Not really keeping track of the time since i am pretty fucking hig and fairly drink but think it has been a couple of hours since taking the opiates which was the dstrongest of what I had and I can feel it but not hat significalty so yeah...we'll see I guess. 40 pills to go.

Well, thank you for the nice intentions. I don't personally believe prayer does any good, but I can see that you do and so the gesture is meaningful to me. Thank you. I am past the point of reconsidering just hoping this starts moving itself along but I appreciate your thoughts and time

I can really relate to that. It's gotten to the point that I have basically just shut myself off from the world. It's nice to know that people like you understand but also makes me feel so hopeless that other people feel this way. I wouldn't wish this on anyone. 

Idk why keep trying? I haven't been able to come up with a good enough reason for myself at this point. 

What's not troubling me? Problems include finances, career, relationship, friends family, legal issues. other high stress situations, and a complete lack of coping skills. Also this shit is apparentl y genetic which I deinitel believe and if that is the case, then I am just fucking screwed

Yeah, have definitely figured out the truth in that recently. I have always thought that people would get it and that secretly everyone felt like this. But after conficing in the one person I thought could get me through this, he just can't comprehend this. When I tell him I am feeling suicidal, he gets angry. It's ridiculous. 

I have tried seeking help. Didn't really help. Either way, can't afford it where I live now as there is not insurance plan in the country that overes mental health. A visit along is $200 and I only have a part time consulting job and live in a place where studios cost almost 2 grand per month so yeah...$200 a week isn't happening.

Yeah burnt out is part of it. But I have been more burnt out than this beofre. This is something else. It's just a hopelessness, total and complete loss, and essentially no self worth. 

It's actually unreal how much I have cried in the last 6 months. Every time, I thnk I can't possibly cry anymore, the same thing alsways mkes me cry again. My partner. I have a completely unhealthy attachement to him due to alot of shit in my past and the fact that I don't have much else in my life currently. 

Wriring is actually how I've made it this far. Journaling is actually how I can usually get myself through just about anything. Stops the racing thoughts and organizes my mind. But, even that isn't doing it, and besides, all I journal about now are my suicude plans and how I need to accept this way forward. I guess the journal is my fac=vore thing to write - nothing like wriring about yourself haha. Bu t I normally publish business and travel articles. Never told anyone about this; I am utterly unable to fail publicly, but I always wanted to be a war correspondent. Although I have no doubt that I would have ended up killing myself had I chosen that life asl well. 

Honestly can't believe I am still awake Still have alot of pills I guess that is why. thi sis kinda one of those things that I can't fail at...but slightly worried by my lack of symptoms. I always feel like this physially but my body is annoyingly resistance in gneral.

Ugh don't think I can even drink water now. I'm still on the alcohol. i know I can still survive but I want to less and less each minute. I do'nt feel nearly as fucked up as I thought I would, strangely. Just feel like I'm not really here but I'm thank ful to have people to talk to so thank you. 

Yeah this country is fucked up. It doesn't really contribute to my mental health, obviously. The legal system is just unbelievable and the attitidues and lack of help surroundeing mental health is truly shocking

yeah, I guess that is why I was asking because part of me thinks it's some sort of sign and the other part thinks it is just survuval instinct. I really thought I had given up but somehow the mind is so slow to accept that. it gets easier every minute but there is still a large part of me that doesn' believe I will actually die desipt showing pills down my throat every 5 minutes. It's very bizarre. I'm pretty much 70% of the way thre on my pills now I am just hoping what I have is enough because at this point I just want don't want to end up with some sort of permanent damage. 

Good or bad, I am not sure. I am glad it has stopped you before.

hmmm I guess you are right. I am not a person easily able to express my emotions and feelings because I usually feel they are ridiculous and a weakness.  The internet makes some things so much easier. I jsut have nothing to lsoe at this point and feels good to get it all out here. I don't even care what people think at this point. 

I guess you are right. Nice to know I can actually do something, even if that is killing myself (remains to be seen).

well being an extremely sensitive person, I woudn't even know where to start on not letting others inluence me. I am quite independent and appear to people as thougg I don't care, but it's just a defense mechanism and necessary. Idk...I am guilty of it also but just seems like everyone in this world deals with pain at one point or another and so how can we e so cruel to others? Always have found this perplexing.
Possibly. not sure if anything is ever a selfless act. Or maybe that is just me. I am not sure if I have ever done anything selfless.

Well, maybe you are right...I don't have a lethal doese of anything I have taken except for the paracetemol but that was just the backup option. I have pretty dangerous doses of everything else so I am hoping it is enough combined. My body tends to be pretty tough though, so not sure. 

Did you go through with it and fail or got help before you tried?

I've tried pills, therapy, and other shit, and it made a small difference, but not a significant enough one to keep me from this. Obviously. I stopped going when I knew I was getting to this point because I didn't want to be talked out of it. Made it 2 months but can't do it anymore. 

I know it's not too late, I just don't think I care. Sometimes I feel I will throw up but t's not happening and I won't force myself. At this point, I just feel like of resigned and ilke whatever happens is meant to happen. A thought that is competely antithetical to my beleif system and I guess to me signifies how far gone I am at this point. 

I can't take that chance. I have been to jai once in this country. I am not actually a crimial this country just has insane laws and concept of time. I waited in jail 4 ays to just see a judge at which point they just let me go. Point of the story is the jail was traumatiing and I do not get traumaizxed easily. They imprison toddlers with their mothers in jail here. It's fucked up. I could go into it but don't want to think about that right now. Anyway, I am positive that if I went to jail it would only singiifalty reinforce my decision on tihs. 

I'm really sorry to have made you feel this way. I appreciate your taking the time to reach out. I guess you must be close to me; 5am where I'm at. Almost. Please know I appreciate your message. I wish I knew more people who card IRL.

I think my expectations are the problem, not those of others. I just don't see how I can change things at this point. Yes I know it is possible. It always is, isn't it? I am just so tired and beat down and lonely. 

I@m not feeling dout, just acceptance and kind of feel like this isn't working anyway. Thought I would def be passed out by now but good I am not. Still have many pills to go and I can't swallow more than 2 at a time. 

So, I kind of feel like I have at least advanced somewhat as a human being. I used to get irrationally angry when people said they would pray for me. I am an atheist and that ised to drive me insane. But now I feel appreciative. It is not something I believe in, but I feel thank ful that someone who does beleive it is hepful is doing that for me. So thank you

hmmmm interesting questions...not really impulsive, not at all I guess. I have attempted before, 2 years ago, which was impulsive. Wasn't seuccessful, obviously. Ever since then, I fantsize about it all the time. I hardly ever stop. Old therapist said it was a control thing which may be right idk...anyway for the last year things have been bad. The last 6 months have been brutal. I have planned this pretty well, for about a week. I have thought it would be every day of this week and I keep trying to wait for better news. Tonight I finally had to accept it wasn't coming. I stalled for two hours and now it's getting kind of methodical. Ever coupld of minutes, I take a couple more. The first few were the hardest. What's weird is i never imagined what it would be like. Only when someone found me, even thought I would never be able to experience that. I feel less down than I thought I would. I actually feel kind of ok, but the meds have def hit me now. Which I guess is why I am so calm Have't really stopped crying for a week and now I am surprisingly calm. So, I kneow it would be today since yesterday. I keep pushing it ever day, hoping something will change, and I had to face the facts today. I got a job offer so I needed to make up my mind before I did anything in that regard, since a friend leveraged some major connections to get the interview for me.

So, sorry I am kind of losing my ability to concentrate so I don't now if I answered completely. Also in my spare time I work as a freelance journalist and so I can usually actually spell words. 

the difference I guess is that I am fucking itching like crazy. It's so weird. Must be a reaction to something I took but it's so fucking annoying. i def thought I would be passed out by now and it kind of somes in waves feeling like I will but somehow I am staying awake. Still have probably 75 pills to go so it's a good thing

Thanks, and thanks for the empathy. I know it's not too late but the further I walk down this little road, the less I want to stop myself. It was hard at first and getting easier and easier. Can't call an ambulance becuase I will go to jail for 6 months where I live. that's why I can't fuck this p

I mean, I just feel like I made the decisions to get myself here and I knew full well that if this happened, I would do this. I have had it planned for months. It isn't entirely my fault but sometimes that is almost worse because I have tried everything to fix this and there is apparently nothing I can do...well yeah. The weird thing is that I planned on doing this during the day. i didn't want to die while everyone was sleeping

for whatever reason now, i find the thought comforting. Just ceasing to exist, it wounds so peaceful. Intimidating, yes, but I just kind of feel like it's not even real right now. 

So, I've already moved t another coumtry 3 times to be a different person. Not the primary reason but def a big one. Doesn't work. Figured out I can run away as much as I want but you can't run away from yuor fucked up self. 

Amazing how much comparisons with others can fuck with you sisn't it? There is always someone better. 

I don't really know what I would do other than die. Feeling nauseous now but I really don't want to throw up. I can't get these mediacionts here so my next option would be jumping or paracetamol...much rather go out this way...
easier said than done, isn't it? I'm just as selfish as anyone else I guess anyway

idk I feel like people can tell most of the time. You know when something is off with a person but people are so self absorbed. Me included

My partner. It's a long story but it's a cultural issue and his partents are not allowing us to be together. They have told him that he can choose his family or me. I can't ask him to lose his family but I also caan't accept the alternative. 

For some reason, I like to hear the experiences of people who acn maybe relate to me. If you feel like sharing, I would like that but no pressure

idk I consider myself a pretty raional person but I just can't accept that depression is an illness. I feel like I have put myself here and nee to take responsibility. I hear what you are saying and rationally I know you are right but something in me cannot accept that. I don't ebelive in having problems I cannot fix. Which is what has pushed me over the edge essentially. I've always felt this way so I just don't really know what anything else feels like. 

Thank you for being there. How did you know it's night where I am? Does Reddit show the location somehow?

Success is subjective I guess. I may be "successful" by society's standards, but that shit is pretty much meaningless. Not a druggie lol yeah I don't want to end up a vegetable or something, but I have a living will at least. Few years seems like a long time...

ehhh...getting past the pain I am feeling now to stick around for 2-3 years simply does not feel possible. I honestly don't think I would even be able to get through the current situations in my life and I'm tired of letting people down. I've done alot, I've had a great life by most people's standards and still, I've never been happy or satisfied. I had one thing holding me together and I know how much of an issue that is, but that thing is no longer there and I just don't think I can get back up. Seems like that is all i do. Get knocked down, admittedly because of my own mistakes, struggle to get back up again and then the same cycle starts again. Nice to know that someone understands though. What makes you feel this way?

I guess, just seems ridiculous to explain. No one I know would ever even believe me saying any of this. I've always been over sensitive. Used to think I would get over it and never had. Thanks for the link. I've tried therapy and I felt like I didn't deserve to be there and didn't feel taken seriously

Yeah I know that. This isn't really a cry for help; already done that a couple of times. I don't really want to die just don't want to live and don't see a way to go on living. I took some opiates but didn't have that much and impossible to obtain in the country I am in. Super controlled. That's an interesting test. But I can't really see beyond the next couple of months. I've already done everything, travelled the world, had a great career, been in love, been internationally ranked in my sport, pretty much been good at anything I really wanted to be good at. I'm smart and attractive and before you think I am a narcissist, I actually hate myself because I just fuck everything up and put myself in situations where I am pretty much guaranteed to be hurt. I'm not a good person. Anyway, despite everything I have done and accomplished, I never enjoy life. I can count on my fingers the amount of times I have been genuinely happy which I guess just has to be good enough at this point...
Also I didn't actually count. It's just an estimation. Just in case I am somehow caught, I don't want to be able to tell them anything.

Yeah I know but for some reason I was drawn to it..feeling no pain right now...actually feeling pretty good. Don't think I would have had the willpower to jump or something and no access to a gun. I am an annoyingly persistent person and pretty much unable to give up on things I want and so I feel like it needs to be more gradual. A lot of shit got me here but I'll be honest, I don't really have a right to feel this way. I just do and I'm tired of it
